whole_frame_support.exact_span: sōna swā hēo hearpian ongan hēo mid wynsumum sange gemęngde ðǣre hearpan swēg Ðā ongunnon ealle ðā męnn hīe hęrian on hiere swēgcræfte
whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: Sōna swā marks as soon as; hearpian is infinitive under began. Gemęngde joins accusative harp-sound and mid/dative song. Hęrian on hiere swēgcræfte praises her with respect to musical skill, not physical location.

whole_frame_support.exact_span: Apollonius āna swīgode Ðā cwæð se cyning Apolloni nū ðū dēst yfele for-ðǣm-ðe ealle męnn hęriað mīne dohtor on hiere swēgcræfte and ðū āna hīe swīgende tǣlst
whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: Apollonius alone remained silent; swīgende accompanies the addressed2sg censure in the quotation. Exact source form is retained and note12a explicitly supplies swīgiende. No new full swīgian system or generalized instrumental participle is tested.

whole_frame_support.exact_span: gif ðū mē gelīefst ic sęcge ðæt ic ongiete ðæt sōðlice ðīn dohtor gefēoll on swēgcræft ac hēo næfð hine nā wel geleornod
whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: Gif ðū mē gelīefst means if you permit me [to speak]; mē is the dative person granted permission and the permitted speaking is understood from the following ic sęcge, I will say. Gelīefst is present indicative2sg, as the original note14 directs to196d; no infinitive is printed or inserted in the source. Cook303 explicitly gives līefan allow,permit; the reading supplies its exact prefixed occurrence. Keep this source-local permission verb separate from the earlier believe sense. The nested content says the daughter has chanced upon music, but has not learned it well. Gefēoll on swēgcræft is the source’s idiom, not literal physical falling; masculine hine resumes swēgcræft.

whole_frame_support.exact_span: hāt mē nū sęllan ðā hearpan ðonne wāst ðū nū ðæt ðū gīet nāst
whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: Hāt governs the act of giving, with mē as dative recipient, as source note164a directs; do not construe it as order me to give. Wāst and nāst are2sg affirmative and contracted-negative know; future knowledge is expressed with present wāst. Nāst is supplied, not a new nytan paradigm.

whole_frame_support.exact_span: swā stōd ðæt se cyning and ealle ðā ymbsittendan wēndon ðæt hē nǣre Apollonius ac ðæt hē wǣre Apollines ðāra hǣðenra god

whole_frame_support.exact_span: Æfter ðisum forlēt Apollonius ðā hearpan and plegode and fela fægerra ðinga ðǣr forðtēah ðe ðǣm folce ungecnāwen wæs and ungewunelic And him eallum ðearle līcode ǣlc ðāra ðinga ðe hē forðtēah
whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: Forlēt means set aside the harp (note5), plegode means performed/acted (note6), and forðtēah presented performances (note8). Fela governs genitive plural fine things; preserve singular ungecnāwen wæs and ungewunelic in the relative without inventing a universal agreement rule. Him eallum are dative people pleased; ǣlc of those things is singular subject of līcode.
